Package com.csse3200.game.rewards

Class ItemDiscoveryService

java.lang.Object
com.csse3200.game.rewards.ItemDiscoveryService
public class ItemDiscoveryService extends Object
Owns permanent item discovery progress independently of the run-scoped item inventory.

    • replaceProgress

      public void replaceProgress(Map<ItemType,ItemUnlockState> restoredProgress)
      Atomically replaces discovery progress. Entries omitted from the input become locked.

      This supports an explicit profile reset. Save-game restoration should use mergeProgress(Map) instead so a stale save cannot hide a discovery made later.

    • mergeProgress
